title: MAX_DEPTH in build_chain not linked to ValidationPolicy::max_path_len
description: build_chain::MAX_DEPTH = 10 and ValidationPolicy::default().max_path_len = 10 are independently hardcoded. If pkix-path changes its default (or a future refactor changes MAX_DEPTH), chains between the two limits will give inconsistent errors (TooDeep from build_chain vs PathTooLong from pkix). Fix: add a comment linking them, or set max_path_len explicitly from MAX_DEPTH in the policy construction: ValidationPolicy { max_path_len: MAX_DEPTH as u8, current_time_unix: now_unix, ..Default::default() }.
